name: hover-card
pattern: An operable non-modal preview opened by hover / focus on a native link or button
responsibility: Provides hover intent, opening and closing, focus preservation, and pointer movement between trigger and content. The user and native HTML own markup, position, dimensions, appearance, and navigation to the link target
implementationBasis: The native manual popover provides display and top layer; the controller provides hover intent and the pointer movement corridor. Radix Hover Card and Base UI Preview Card are not adopted as the public model for an operable preview because they do not provide internal keyboard / screen-reader operation. Measurements of native focus and Tab remain in test/native_hover_preview.test.ts and docs/notes/browser-engine-differences.md

authorMarkup.trigger: One named a[href] or button[type=button] trigger target. Preserve the link href and native navigation
authorMarkup.preview: For a link trigger, place one named button[type=button] preview target that can open the preview on touch. Omit it for a button trigger
authorMarkup.content: One HTMLElement content target with popover="manual". Place trigger, preview (link configuration only), and content as consecutive siblings of the same parent in this order to preserve native Tab order
authorMarkup.close: One named button[type=button] close target inside content
authorMarkup.semantics: Use ordinary HTML semantics for content; the controller does not add tooltip / dialog / menu roles. Links, buttons, and form controls may be inside. The user supplies the trigger accessible name and the meaning, headings, and labels inside
authorMarkup.restrictions: Do not place autofocus on content or descendants, and do not hide content or operable targets with hidden, aria-hidden=true, or inert. Positive tabindex reordering and CSS placement that overlays content on the trigger and blocks operation are outside the scope
authorMarkup.style: The user CSS determines position, gap, dimensions, z-index, transition, and RTL placement. The controller does not write layout properties or classes

targets: There is exactly one trigger / content / close, all inside the root
A link trigger has exactly one preview; a button trigger has no preview
trigger / preview / close have accessible names and buttons are type=button
trigger / preview / content follow the defined sibling order and close is inside content
content has no autofocus, popover is omitted or manual, and the Popover API is available
openDelay and closeDelay are finite numbers at least 0

completion.warning: Supplement missing static attributes and issue one standard English completion warning while connected. Preserve authored attribute values

completionExempt: Synchronizing trigger and preview aria-expanded with state
contractValidation.invalidMarkup: Issue one warning while connected, disable enhancement, and remove listeners and timers. When markup becomes invalid while displayed or targets are replaced, close the previous content and synchronize state. Do not infer or supplement names or meanings
contractValidation.warning: Manage enhancement-disabled and completion warnings with separate flags

openDelay.description: Milliseconds from pointer hover to open. Focus and button click are immediate. Apply value changes to the next timer started

closeDelay.description: Milliseconds from pointer leaving trigger / content / movement corridor to close. Focus exit, Escape, and close button are immediate. Apply value changes to the next timer started

open.description: Current native popover state. The setter clears timers and commits state without dispatching a custom event

show().description: Show without moving focus or dispatching a custom event

hide().description: Hide without dispatching a custom event

events.programmatic: Export HoverCardToggleDetail. The API, initialization, target/value changes, disconnect, and external showPopover / hidePopover do not dispatch custom events. Exclude synthetic events by isTrusted. Preserve pointer reason as the origin of hover delays

managedMarkup.relationships: When content has no id, assign one without collision in ownerDocument and supplement trigger and preview aria-controls only when absent. Follow controller-completed values through content replacement and id changes. Preserve authored values and values changed after completion. Supplement link-trigger tabindex with 0 only when absent
managedMarkup.expanded: Synchronize trigger and preview aria-expanded with native popover visibility
managedMarkup.popover: Supplement missing popover=manual. Do not commit open state or notification when native beforetoggle cancels display or the Popover API fails
managedMarkup.state: Output data-state=open | closed on root, trigger, preview (when present), and content

behavior.link: Open preview when the link is hovered or focused. Do not prevent default click / Enter or modified clicks. The preview button opens the same content on click / tap
behavior.focus: Do not close on pointer exit or timer while focus is on trigger, preview, or inside content. Show immediately from a focus origin and allow the next Tab to enter content. The controller does not move focus when showing. Preserve reason=pointer for focus-driven open/close associated with trusted pointer operations
behavior.hover: Do not treat touch pointerenter / pointerleave as hover. Mouse and pen use open/close delays. Treat trigger and preview as the same origin region
behavior.safePolygon: When moving from trigger / preview to content or content back to the origin, retain the pointer inside a convex corridor built from the actual exit and destination rectangles. Do not close while inside; close after closeDelay once outside. Use the same geometry for all directions and RTL without blocking other elements' pointer events
behavior.dismiss: Close with Escape and the close button. Return focus to the trigger for a user close only when focus is inside content. Do not move focus when closing is canceled. Do not reopen immediately from lingering hover / focus after closing; wait for new interaction after leaving the region or explicit open
behavior.cancel: When beforetoggle is canceled, do not change state or toggle notification. Do not later commit the original request if a listener calls the API, disconnects, or replaces targets
behavior.external: Read external showPopover / hidePopover toggles from current native state. Do not roll state back from an old toggle newState. Initial state follows native visibility

keyboard.Tab: Move in native order through trigger, preview (link configuration), content controls, and outside. The controller does not prevent default Tab behavior
keyboard.Shift+Tab: Move in reverse native order. Supplement link tabindex with 0 when absent
keyboard.Enter: Use native navigation for links; for buttons, open or close preview as a click
keyboard.Space: Use native button click. Do not duplicate it with custom keydown
keyboard.Escape: Close even when opened by hover. Return focus to trigger only when closing from inside content. Do not process Escape when another widget called preventDefault

lifecycle: Register listeners and the markup observer in connect, and remove timers, movement corridor, observer, and listeners in disconnect

Revalidate target/value changes. Preserve hover and started timers for valid content updates with the same targets. When targets are replaced, close previous content and do not apply old timers to new targets
After disconnect with DOM retained, API and events do not enhance; do not duplicate listeners on reconnection

observations.environment: Screen readers on real devices; exact previously tested versions not recorded
observations.item: Announcement order, wording, and suitability of announcements for individual interactions
observations.impact: The recorded user acceptance of catalog readability is limited, not complete speech verification. Public preview behavior and native control semantics are fixed; cross-reader phrasing remains observational.

acceptanceCriteria: Meet WCAG 2.2 AA, especially 1.4.13 dismissible / hoverable / persistent and 2.1.1
Meet AAA 2.1.3 Keyboard (No Exception) with a keyboard equivalent for every pointer operation inside the preview
Meet AAA 3.2.5 Change on Request. Timers do not move focus, and showing does not steal focus
Verify both button and link configurations, native navigation, the touch button, Tab movement, and safe polygon in Chromium / Firefox / WebKit

Real-device verification and acceptance (2026-09-07): a user confirmed that the catalog can be read with VoiceOver and accepted the automatically verified behavior. aria-expanded / data-state synchronization, internal Tab operation, and post-close focus return were verified by browser tests in all three engines. Individual announcement wording on the device was not evaluated and this is not complete speech verification

Observation and unverified: differences in announcement order and wording between screen readers and suitability of announcements for each operation. The real-device OS / browser / VoiceOver versions were not recorded. Retain this as a compatibility observation independent of the public specification

testMatrix.description: State, relationships, completion, and authored-attribute preservation for both configurations
Focus, Tab, Escape, and preservation and return of internal focus
Independence of native navigation and the preview button
Delays, movement corridor, pointer exit, and RTL
Cancellation, reentrancy, programmatic silence, and event properties
Target replacement, disconnect, reconnection, and value changes
Invalid markup, autofocus, accessible names, and warning separation
